content.thinking: Now I can see the draft against the poster. Six current-year station cards plus two that are not this year's corner, a 2025 Fruits card and a VBS snack station, which stay out of scope. The six: Dairy Order 1, Fruits 2, Grains 3, Oils & Fats 4, Proteins 5, Vegetable 6. That is straight alphabetical, exactly the jumble Valerie described when she sorted the list, and it is nothing like the poster order. Against the poster it should be Proteins 1, Fruits 2, Dairy 3, Vegetable 4, Grains 5. Worse, the two key messages are swapped: Dairy carries 'Gives you energy to run and play' and Grains carries 'Builds strong bones and teeth', but the poster has bones and teeth under Dairy and energy under Grains. So Dana's claim that the cards already match the poster is simply false on both counts. And Oils & Fats is the extra card, matching the handout's 'Plus: oils and fats in small amounts' line, not any poster column. Plan: patch five orders, swap the two messages back, archive the oils card. I will GET each page first so I am writing against what is really there.
